int* sieve(int n) {
    int* a = new int[n + 1];
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) a[i] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= sqrt(n); i++) {
        if (a[i] == 1) {
            for (int k = 2; i * k <= n; k++) {
                a[i * k] = 0;
            }
        }
    }
    return a;
}

vector<int> gd(int a, int b) {
    int m = (int)gcd(a, b);
    vector<int> q;
    for (int i = 1; i * i <= m; ++i) {
        if (m % i == 0) {
            q.push_back(i);
            if (i != m / i) q.push_back(m / i);
        }
    }
    return q;
}

bool cal(int val, int k, int t) {
    int res = val, p = 1;
    while (val / pow(k, p) > 0) {
        res += val / pow(k, p);
        p++;
    }
    return res >= t;
}

int Last_Ocuu(int a[], int n, long long v) {
    int start = 0, end = n - 1, mid, ans = -1;
    while (start <= end) {
        mid = (start + end) >> 1;
        if (a[mid] >= v) {
            ans = mid;
            end = mid - 1;
        } else if (a[mid] < v) {
            start = mid + 1;
        }
    }
    return ans;

bool Last_Ocuu(long long a[], int n, long long v) {
